text_block_list.text:
“WINNING DREAM STAGE” ― The student council
convened that day to 
discuss the upcoming live concert to
commemorate the 
establishment of the world of Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…That concludes the agenda 
for the anniversary live concert.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Air Groove. With that,
our meeting is concluded… 
Oh, it seems as though the curtain of night
has already fallen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…I'm so hungry. 
This meeting took way too long.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Brian! What's with your attitude!?
You're the vice president, so 
you should understand the importance and
significance of this 
anniversary live concert…!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well… Brian, I understand 
that things will get busy. Hmm,
maybe we should 
come up with a solution for…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy!! Air Groove!! 
We're here to lend y'all a helping hand!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Brian is such a stubborn person! 
If you need Maya's help,
I'll finish it in a flash♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf,
is there anything that I can do to help
with 
the anniversary live concert?…Everyone seems
so excited for it… So I'd like to help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Girls…! Heh… Hahaha! 
The future's looking bright!
Our path forward is clear!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you.
Let's work together and push forward to
make 
sure the anniversary live concert goes off
without a hitch!
